Generator version, slot and32-lowercase-hex seed have different admitted roles. Canonical default character is a complete product default, not a compatibility fallback. Public raw strings/integers and publicSerde records can express combinations the private generator never produces: professional role requires a non-young tier and matching organization role; sparse trait Vec can carry opposite/same-axis duplicates, whereas young generator chooses2-4distinct axes and professional presets choose compatible traits. Canonical trait/axis owners already exist. StartingSkills repeats SkillHours fields alongside written-language state; from_life_simulation maps one-to-one and the actual bestiary-category override correctly selects each leaf, qualifying the earlier default-trait concern. Healthy aptitudes, hours, currency amount and fraction are not one numeric role.
role_dispositions.remedy: Admit generation coordinates once; use canonical catalog/organization/skill/religion/character identity owners and keep quantities/currency/time separate. Consolidate shared training-hours state under canonical SkillHours with written-language projection instead of a duplicate30-field owner. Reuse canonical personality-axis/value payloads for sparse selected traits, preserving independent sex/presentation/inclination. Model generated young versus professional start as payload-owning states if that is the public contract; preserve default selection intentionally rather than infer every tier has exact preset age. Coherent loadout recipes can own item-plus-slot/auxiliary-ammunition relationships. No new tighter attribute/rank bound is justified by this lens.
